subject: Confidential: termination planning for Alex Singh
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential: termination recommendation — Alex Singh

Team,

I need to escalate a personnel matter that requires HR/legal/finance coordination. After multiple coaching cycles and the PIP that closed last week, I am recommending we terminate Alex Singh (Senior BE Engineer) for repeated missed deliverables, unresponsiveness to AC-level escalations, and a recent data handling incident that we documented on 2026-08-14. I have attached the performance summary and the PIP timeline for context.

Proposed approach:
- Effective date: week of 2026-08-24 (aim to notify on 8/24)
- Severance: 8 weeks base pay + continuation of benefits through end of month (TBD by HR/Legal)
- Return of equipment: laptop + security token + badge; disable remote access immediately after notice
- Communications: manager-led notification with HR present; limited written statement for internal comms

Please confirm whether Legal wants to review the language in the severance agreement and what Finance needs to prepare for a lump-sum payout. Also need SRE/IT to prepare for credential revocation windows.

Marked confidential — please respond only to thread participants.

Thanks,

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Backend Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: perf_summary_alex.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: termination recommendation — Alex Singh

Markus —

Thanks for the detailed note and for flagging the confidentiality. HR has reviewed the PIP materials you attached. A few requests before we proceed:

1) Can you put together a single-page timeline of the PIP coaching touchpoints and any formal warnings (bullet points, dates)? I will attach that to the employee file.
2) Confirm whether there is any active customer-facing work that will need immediate reassignment. If so, provide the list of repos/services and primary stakeholders.
3) Legal wants to review and edit the severance offer — I will loop them in after we agree on terms.

From a process standpoint, I recommend the following interim terms to start the conversation with Legal/Finance: 8 weeks base pay, continuation of benefits through the end of the month following termination, and a standard mutual release. We will run this past CompassHR for benchmarking before finalizing.

I will draft a termination checklist and proposed timeline; attaching a working checklist.

Laura Bennett
Sr. HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: working_termination_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Casey Park <casey@compasshr.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Draft severance + proposed timeline (internal) — Alex Singh

Laura/Markus —

Attached is a first draft of the severance agreement (severance_agreement_v1.pdf). It follows our standard template but with the 8-week payment language and benefits continuation clause that Laura suggested.

Proposed notification timeline:
- 8/24 10:00am PT: Manager (Markus) + HR (Laura) + People Ops (Mina) conduct the notification call with Alex
- Immediately after call: IT/Security to revoke remote access and rotate service keys for accounts Alex had access to
- 8/25 EOD: Finance to prepare severance payment (lump sum) pending signed agreement

Markus — please confirm the list of systems Alex needs to be removed from (CI/CD, repo access, GCP projects). Rishi — can you confirm whether Finance needs any special coding for a lump-sum taxable payout vs. regular payroll?

Note: I copied Casey at CompassHR for benchmarking; they have agreed to a quick review this afternoon.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Head of People Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: severance_agreement_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Casey Park <casey@compasshr.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft severance + proposed timeline (internal) — Alex Singh

Thanks for the ping. Quick read — the package looks reasonable for a non-executive engineer with the incident history you mentioned. A couple of suggested edits to protect the company and reduce post-employment risk:

- Add a short non-disparagement clause for both parties.
- Add explicit return-of-property language and a 48-hour window for equipment shipment if not returned in person.
- Consider conditioning full severance payment on receipt of signed release within 14 days (benchmarked against regional norms).

Benchmarking note: 6–8 weeks is typical for employees with 3+ years of service in our dataset; 8 weeks is defensible here. If you want, I can mark up the PDF and return within 2 hours.

Casey Park
Senior Consultant, CompassHR
[Attachment: compass_comments_sev_v1.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Casey Park <casey@compasshr.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized terms & notification window — Alex Singh

Team —

Based on the internal review and CompassHR notes, we will proceed with the following final terms:
- Severance: 8 weeks base pay (lump-sum)
- Benefits: continuation through 2026-09-30 (company-sponsored portion)
- Release: Mutual release with non-disparagement clause; signature required within 14 days
- Equipment: Return within 48 hours OR pre-paid shipping label; company to withhold final payout if equipment not returned per policy

Notification call scheduled: 2026-08-24 at 10:00am PT. Markus + Laura will lead. Dylan/Mina on standby for ops. Rishi — please confirm Finance will prepare the lump-sum payout once signed agreement is returned; center the payment as taxable lump-sum with standard deductions.

Attaching a consolidated checklist (termination_checklist.xlsx) and a redlined severance for Legal.

Laura Bennett
Sr. HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: termination_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 32KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Casey Park <casey@compasshr.com>, Alex Singh <alex.singh@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-notification checklist & access revocation — Alex Singh

Quick operational follow-up after the 10:00 call (Markus + Laura led the notification):

- Notification: Completed at 10:00am PT; Alex acknowledged receipt and said he will review the agreement. He requested a one-week window to consult a family attorney, which Laura said is within our 14-day signature window.
- Access revocation: IT confirmed remote access revoked at 10:15am; repo tokens rotated and GCP service keys replaced for impacted projects.
- Equipment: Alex will drop off the laptop at HQ mailroom by 48 hours or use pre-paid label; Mina to confirm tracking number.
- Finance: Rishi to hold on disbursing until signed release is returned; prepare payroll code for lump-sum.

Next steps:
- Laura to send the official severance package + pre-paid shipping label to Alex by end of day.
- Mina to confirm badge deactivation and collect any outstanding physical keys.
- Rishi to prepare payout workflow and confirm taxation treatment.

Thanks all for the quick coordination — keeping this tight and confidential.

Dylan Brooks
Head of People Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
